successors.name: Roman Empire
successors.text: the five authorities plus Essex around Camulodunum (conf-1 guess)

ledger.x: c. 20 BC: coinage at Verlamion. Tasciovanus 'was the first king to mint coins at Verlamion, beginning ca 20 BC' (rulers list: c. 20 BC to AD 9). The date is the start of the coinage, not of a state; the page names Cassivellaunus c. 54 BC only as 'possibly' associated with the tribe.
Camulodunum, page silent on date and holder.

wars.name: Roman invasion of Britain
wars.outcome: Roman victory: Togodumnus died after the battle on the Thames and the Catuvellauni's land became the nucleus of the Roman province.
